lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: Hello again! Gus here. I've been digging in my vegetable patch and thinking about <color=red>dinosaurs</color>.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: I wrote five sentences about them, but I've muddled up some words. Choose the right word for each gap, and five new <color=red>books</color> will go to the library!

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 1:
Dinosaurs lived millions of years ago, long before any <color=red>_____</color> existed.
lines.hint: Not quite. Which of these arrived on Earth much, much later than the dinosaurs?
lines.correctText: Dinosaurs lived millions of years ago, long before any <color=red>humans</color> existed.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 2:
Brachiosaurus had an extremely long <color=red>_____</color>, so it could reach leaves high in the trees.
lines.hint: Not quite. Which body part would help it stretch up to the treetops?
lines.correctText: Brachiosaurus had an extremely long <color=red>neck</color>, so it could reach leaves high in the trees.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 3:
Triceratops had three sharp <color=red>_____</color> on its head to protect itself.
lines.hint: Not quite. What sharp, pointy things could protect an animal?
lines.correctText: Triceratops had three sharp <color=red>horns</color> on its head to protect itself.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 4:
Tyrannosaurus rex was one of the <color=red>_____</color> meat-eaters that ever lived.
lines.hint: Not quite. 'One of the' compares it with every meat-eater that ever lived.
lines.correctText: Tyrannosaurus rex was one of the <color=red>largest</color> meat-eaters that ever lived.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 5:
Last year, scientists <color=red>_____</color> a new dinosaur skeleton in the desert.
lines.hint: Not quite. 'Last year' tells you this happened in the past.
lines.correctText: Last year, scientists <color=red>discovered</color> a new dinosaur skeleton in the desert.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: Brilliant, every gap is filled! Five new books are on their way to the <color=red>library</color>.

afterLines.speaker: Gus
afterLines.text: Thanks again! Did you know lots of dinosaurs were <color=red>herbivores</color>? They'd have adored my lettuces.
